name: Where Fish Live
description: Water, biome, depth, time, weather, moon, season, and fished-out spots.

pages.title: Where Fish Live
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Ocean and beach** water is salt; rivers, lakes and everything else is fresh.
- The **biome** and its temperature decide most fish.
- **Depth** matters: below y40 you catch cave fish.
- **Time, weather, moon and season** decide the rare ones.

A fish's journal page lists what it wants once you catch it. Before that, a **Fishy Note** shows the page.\
\
Most fish also have a favourite **temperature**: in the wrong climate they still bite, just rarely. Fiery and Permafrost hooks nudge it. A lake counts as the land biome around it.

**Fresh water** (rivers, lakes, swamps): trout, pike, perch, crappie, bass, walleye, carp, catfish and more. Swamps, jungles, deserts, cherry groves and frozen lakes each have their own.\
\
**Salt water**: cod, snapper, flounder, anchovy, tuna, sharks, rays, sailfish and Hybrid Aquatic's reef fish.

**Underground** (water below y40): cave eels, glowfish, groupers, and the ore fish: **Iron Tetra**, **Gilded Minnow**, **Lapis Lanternfish**, **Crystal Shrimp**. Deeper means stranger fish; the deep dark, dripstone caves and trial chambers have their own.\
\
Alex's Caves biomes have their own fish too.

**Rare fish** want a moment:

- Five planet fish each bite in the ocean under one moon phase.
- **Shooting Starfish**: deep ocean, full moon, at night.
- **Coelacanth**: deep ocean, at night in rain.
- **Bull Shark**: rivers from evening to morning.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Legendary fish:** Shooting Starfish, Coelacanth, Devils Hole Pupfish (a narrow cave band, y20 to y30), Midas Fish (underground, needs 5 luck), Alpha Fish (Overworld void) and Dragon Fish (End void). Catch one for **One in a Million**.

**Seasons** count: some fish bite only in some seasons (brook trout skip autumn, sturgeon come in autumn and winter). The journal shows which.\
\
Gadgets that show time, moon, depth, temperature and weather: [#](2E5AAC)[Fishing Gadgets](entry://fishing/gadgets)[#]().

**What you offer** decides which of the fish living there bite:

- the bait or lure each species likes
- the hook and bait size against its mouth
- how visible the line is, for shy fish
- the depth the rig sits at: a sinker reaches bottom fish
- a lure's speed

**Fished-out spots.** Every fish landed tires its [#](7A3C9A)[chunk](entry://glossary/chunk)[#](): after four quick catches bites come half as often, and never less than a fifth. The tiredness halves every 10 minutes, so moving on, or trolling, pays.\
\
A released fish doesn't tire the spot. [#](2E5AAC)[Chum](entry://fishing/live_bait)[#]() brings bites back up.
